notes.title: Virtual Pool 4 Update, version 4.1.5.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Update rail model for billiards for better rail paths, tuned using Conti, .7 and other systems
[*]Update rail model for pool for better rail paths
[*]Updated all trick and artistic shots
[*]Some tweaks to rack for better break
[*]Twirling friction while ball is rolling
[*]Make table lines white, add ball position marks for Cowboy
[*]Disallow push out after a foul
[*]Fix Straight Pool where miscall was not checking for illegal break
[*]Fix Blackball where re-break choice was offered after break foul when it should be normal foul
[*]Straight pool was erroneously calling a foul, cue not hit out of kitchen after a ball knocked off table
[*] Fix move ball not working for Straight Pool after cue not played out of kitchen
[*]Fix shot clock, was not giving extra time after break for 8-Ball
[/list]

notes.title: Virtual Pool 4 Update, version 4.1.4.9
notes.notes:
This update message is actually covers the last few version. Some changes such as pocket difficulty have been tweaked across the last 2 version:
[list]
[*] Snooker pockets made easier for all tables (Novice, Club, and Tournament)
[*] Pool pockets made easier for Novice and Club tables
[*] Pub pool pockets mad easier, Novice and Club a lot, Tournament a little
[*] Fix bug where 3 foul rule was applied by default to Snooker
[*] Fix bug were some UK pub games allowed 8 ball to be hit first after break without a foul
[*] Online browser now supports html5/h.264 video
[/list]

notes.title: Virtual Pool 4 Update, version 4.1.4.4
notes.notes:
VP4 has been updated with the following changes:
[list]
[*]Add game option for Foul & Miss
[*]New Snooker pocket back sounds
[*]Fix Snooker bug where points left are equal and Foul & Miss was not called
[*]Fix Snooker bug where scratch on legal ball hit with Free Ball called Foul & Miss
[*]Fix Pub 8-Ball bug where touching black was not recognized
[*]Fix bowlliards miscal after turn end
[*]Fix custom Snooker table setup always using tight pockets
[*]Fix Snooker Foul & Miss not being called when ball jumped off table
[*]Fix English Billiards bug where not hitting a ball when both balls are in baulk and cue is in hand in D would give a play choice instead of foul and play as is
[*]Fix English Billiard bug where red potted off spot count was not reset for another scoring turn with another ball resulting in an improper spot of red to center spot
[/list]

notes.title: Virtual Pool 4 Update
notes.notes:
Virtual Pool 4 has been updated. The Snooker table has been reworked to play more like a professional tournament snooker table. Snooker enhancements:
[list]
    [*] Tournament pockets are larger, now same as Club table
    [*] Table roll is considerably faster
    [*] Table roll is more slippery
    [*] Rail friction is reduced
    [*] Rails are slightly more bouncy
    [*] Angles off rails and ball paths are different
[/list]

Online enhancements:
[list]
    [*] Same Snooker table modifications so offline and online are the same
    [*] Added same game options found in Match rooms to tournaments
    [*] Added additional handicap types to tournaments, Points, Money Balls, Ball Goals
[/list] 

Bug fixes:
[list]
    [*] Leader board graphic fixed
    [*] Achievement for kick safe now works
    [*] Key mapper was not showing extended characters
[/list]
